notes:
Inbound from self-serve signup (trial credits used). Early discovery call 2026-03-05. Team: 3 devs, 1 founder-CEO (Clara Hsu). Building in-app chat assistant for their B2B CRM product (in-app contextual help + quick docs). Key asks: streaming partial responses (SSE/websocket), low tail latency (aim 80-200ms for short responses), token-level cost visibility, and easy fallback to smaller model during spikes.

Quote from call: "Users abandon typing if bot stalls >300ms — need snappy streaming or live typing UX."

POC plan discussed: dev sends 1k representative short conversations (avg 18 tokens/chunk) + traffic profile by next week. SE will run a 2-hour perf sweep on hosted_api with streaming enabled and report p50/p95/p99 and bytes/sec. Interested in region: us-west (primary) + us-east failover.

Security: they require SSO/SAML and audit logs; legal asked about DPA and retention defaults. They are comfortable with public cloud but want explicit confirmation of data handling and ability to set retention windows.

Model preferences: prefer open models with provable latency (we discussed redwood catalog + lower-cost variants). Cost sensitivity: high — target <$0.10 per active user/month for chat infra.

Ops notes: signed up via product, used free credits to test simple prompt flows; saw higher latency on other vendor during peak tests. Asking about SDKs (JS mobile + web), streaming examples, and code snippets for reconnect and partial message reconciliation.

Next internal: create scoped perf run (Liam), send quickstart showing streaming SSE and token accounting (Maya). Legal contact: will share DPA template once product perf looks good.
